scope.serpens: One IAU constellation ID (ser), with two chart panels and two boundary text segments; never split into two IDs.
scope.russian_names_note: Draft standard Russian-language constellation names; the IAU table itself provides Latin and English forms, so Russian localization remains an editorial mapping rather than an IAU-published field.

iau.title: The 88 IAU Constellations
iau.claims: Official page lists Latin names, official abbreviations, English names, charts and boundary downloads. The linked boundary TXT format gives right ascension and declination coordinates in J2000 and the abbreviation. The IAU charts are J2000 and CC BY 4.0; do not assume that image license statement covers boundary files.

stellarium_modern.license: The modern sky-culture description states text and data CC BY-SA 4.0; illustrations separately Free Art License. Only index.json machine-readable line data is proposed, not illustrations.
stellarium_modern.id_convention: Stellarium guide describes lines as arrays of polylines with numbers usually Hipparcos HIP identifiers; all numeric references used in the 88 modern constellation figures were crossmatched as HIP IDs.
stellarium_modern.coordinate_epoch: The line file stores HIP IDs, not coordinates. Join to a separately licensed star table; HYG v4.1 records RA/Dec at epoch and equinox 2000.0.
stellarium_modern.boundaries: index.json marks edges_type=iau, edges_source=https://pbarbier.com/constellations/edges_18.txt and edges_epoch=B1875. This differs from its artist-selected star line figures and from the IAU linked TXT boundary coordinate exports.
stellarium_modern.serpens: The index has one CON modern Ser figure with two disconnected line groups; one record and one ID.

hyg_v41.attribution: HYG Database v4.1, David Nash / Astronexus
hyg_v41.identity: Match Stellarium line IDs to HYG hip, not HYG id (the latter is the database primary key).
hyg_v41.coordinates: README says RA and Dec are epoch/equinox 2000.0.

crossmatch.result: All 710 unique line HIPs resolved in the pinned HYG v4.1 hip field; 54 are present in project stars-source.json, 656 are absent from that 56-row subset. No star coordinates have been fabricated.

iau_asset_verification.expected: 87 ordinary constellation rows use one chart and boundary file each; Serpens has two panels and two boundary-segment files, keeping the count at 88 unique constellation IDs.
directly_opened_assets: Serpens Caput PDF and ser1 TXT
Serpens Cauda PDF and ser2 TXT
iau_asset_verification.remaining: All listed asset hrefs were matched from official IAU table HTML; only the above sample assets were individually fetched/opened.

evidence.result: Opened IAU official list and retrieved table HTML; confirmed all object-specific chart/boundary hrefs (89 files of each kind because Serpens has two components but is one ID).
Opened raw Aquila boundary coordinates, format matches official J2000 RA|Dec|abbreviation description.
Opened official Serpens Caput chart panel.
Opened Serpens Caput boundary segment; remains part of one Serpens constellation.
Opened official Serpens Cauda chart panel.
Opened Serpens Cauda boundary segment; remains part of one Serpens constellation.
Opened pinned machine-readable index; parsed 88 modern figures and 710 unique line-star HIP IDs; preserved source polylines.
Opened modern sky-culture description; authorship Stellarium team and data CC BY-SA 4.0; illustration license is separately stated.
Opened Stellarium guide; documents HIP line identifiers and the separate official-boundary epoch/source fields.
Stream-read pinned HYG v4.1 CSV rows=119626; parsed hip field and matched every unique Stellarium constellation-line HIP. No coordinates were copied into the draft.
Opened HYG README: v4.1 license/attribution, hip field distinct from HYG primary key, and RA/Dec epoch/equinox 2000.0.

limitations: Research candidate only; no production catalog, map or articles changed.
Modern constellation polylines are a Stellarium educational style, not a unique IAU-mandated star figure; editorial approval is needed before replacing current eight patterns.
Russian display names are standard-language draft mappings; the IAU source itself supplies Latin and English only.
The 89 hrefs were extracted and matched for all rows, but only named sample chart/boundary assets were individually opened.
No build, tests, browser automation, content import, Git index operation, commit or publish was run.
